# Tight-heading fixture

CommonMark lets an ATX heading sit flush against a paragraph on either side,
so the roster below has its own heading directly above it and the next section
directly below, with no blank lines. Both are paragraph boundaries even though
neither is blank. Walking outward on blankness alone swept them into the
roster's paragraph and reported a reflow of a roster that is one complete line
with nothing unread — and told the author to add a blank line before prose that
does not exist.
### ADR roster
001 Architecture overview · 002 Multi-platform strategy
